senses.def: A former miskrada of Lypovets Raion, Rivne Oblast, Ukraine, disestablished in June 2020.
A former raion of Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine, established in January 1923, disestablished in July 2020.
An urban hromada of Vinnytsia Raion, Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine, established in June 2020.
A village, the administrative centre of Lyptsi rural hromada, Kharkiv Raion, Kharkiv Oblast, Ukraine, founded in 1660.
A rural hromada of Kharkiv Raion, Kharkiv Oblast, Ukraine, established in June 2020.
The Ukrainian name for Liptsy, a former khutor in Krasnaya Yaruga Raion, Belgorod Oblast, Central Federal District, Russia, disestablished in 2001.
an antidiuretic and vasoconstrictor used to treat diabetes insipidus
The synthetic hormone lysine vasopressin (LVP) that is a form of the naturally occurring antidiuretic hormone (vasopressin) found in pigs.
Any moth in the family Lypusidae.
